description: Unofficial Mari fan-art companion based on the Headspace acrylic-illustration appearance from OMORI: deep-purple hair, dark vest, pink bow and muted purple skirt. Original gentle actions include arranging a miniature picnic, playing a toy paper piano, folding a napkin flower and articulated running with a picnic basket. Opaque purple tights are an original modest adaptation. No traumatic themes; not affiliated with OMOCAT.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
